executionPolicy.antiLoopRule: Reject work unless it verifies a missing exit criterion, removes a named completion blocker, or safely advances beyond a deferred true human gate.
executionPolicy.waveSuccessRule: A wave is productive only if it verifies an exit criterion, clears a gate, integrates an exact-SHA candidate, emits a receipt, closes a macrocycle, or advances the execution cursor past a true human gate.
executionPolicy.blockedProjectRule: A true human gate blocks only its exact sensitive action and strictly dependent work; it is persisted to pendingHumanGates and never stops the project scheduler or other enabled projects.
executionPolicy.fanOutRule: Dispatch closure work independently for every enabled project and continue safe work even when one or more human gates are pending.

active.title: Feedback, dolore, recupero e adattamento
active.outcome: Real feedback safely modifies subsequent recommendations.

exitCriteria.description: Authenticated session feedback including effort, pain, recovery and completion state is durably persisted and linked to the exact workout result/session version.
Pain and stop-condition feedback fails closed and prevents unsafe automatic progression while preserving an attributable decision trail.
Subsequent recommendation or plan adaptation consumes persisted feedback and produces a bounded, explainable change rather than browser-local or query-only behavior.
Product CI, independent review, realistic Robot feedback-to-adaptation journey, exact-SHA verification, integration and post-merge replay all pass and a completion receipt is persisted.

completed.title: Database operativo, persistenza e audit foundation

active.title: Catalogo prodotti, MINSAN, EAN e ricerca universale
active.outcome: Operators can reliably find and maintain real product records.

exitCriteria.description: Canonical persistent product records support validated MINSAN, EAN/barcode and operator-maintained identifying fields with explicit uniqueness/conflict behavior.
A real operator can create or maintain a product and reopen the same durable record after restart with every mutation attributable in audit.
Universal product lookup reliably resolves supported identifiers and text queries, handles ambiguous or missing matches safely, and does not silently create duplicate canonical products.
Import or reconciliation paths for product identifiers are idempotent, validate malformed/conflicting identifiers and preserve canonical data transactionally.
Product CI, independent review, PFarma delta Robot plus required cumulative simulation, exact-SHA integration and post-merge cumulative replay all pass and a completion receipt is persisted.

active.title: Libreria, timeline e navigazione completa
active.outcome: The persistent archive is browsable through one coherent journey.

exitCriteria.description: Authenticated family members can browse durable media through a persistent library that is sourced from canonical stored metadata rather than browser-local state.
Timeline ordering and pagination are deterministic across restart and remain stable for equal timestamps, newly uploaded items and deleted or restored media.
Library navigation opens the exact durable media object and preserves authorization, metadata consistency and fail-closed handling for missing or unhealthy objects.
Empty, loading, pagination boundary, deleted-item and object-failure states are explicit and recoverable without silently losing or duplicating archive entries.
Product CI, independent review, realistic Robot library-to-media journey, exact-SHA integration and post-merge replay all pass and a completion receipt is persisted.

transitionRule: Certified completion activates the next macrocycle immediately. A true human gate keeps its macrocycle OPEN as DEFERRED_HUMAN_GATE in pendingHumanGates but also advances the execution cursor so autonomous independent work never stops.
reconciliationRule: Before every wave, replace stale PR, SHA, integration, completion and human-gate fields using live GitHub evidence and commit ancestry; revisit pending human gates on every trigger.
